statement.zh: Cascajal 石板为美洲「最早文字」且无争议——排序与文字定义仍假说。
statement.en: That the Cascajal block is uncontested "oldest writing" in the Americas remains a definitional/ranking hypothesis.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: script status and "oldest" ranking remain contested.
